cards.title: Throne Room
cards.description: Five rank tapestries line the hall — Soldier, Scout, Marshal, Chronicler, Champion. King Aldric fidgets with a festival program. Pip waits, arms full of scrolls.
cards.image_prompt: A grand medieval throne room with soaring vaulted ceilings and tall stained-glass windows casting jewel-toned light. A jovial king in golden robes sits on an ornate carved wooden throne, fidgeting with a scroll. A small eager apprentice stands nearby clutching an armful of scrolls. Five tapestries along the wall depict knights of ascending rank. Warm golden light, rich parchment tones, ornate stone columns.

cards.title: Steward's Study
cards.description: An oak desk buried in Pip's notes. An errand board of five wax-sealed tasks, a shelf of handbooks, and a speaking tube to the courtyard for dispatching knights. A Knight Rank Chart hangs by the door.
cards.image_prompt: A cozy medieval study with a large oak desk covered in scattered parchment notes. A wooden errand board on the wall displays five tasks with red wax seals. A brass speaking tube protrudes from the wall. Bookshelves filled with leather-bound handbooks. A knight rank chart hangs beside a heavy wooden door. Warm candlelight, quill and ink on the desk, intimate scholarly atmosphere.

cards.title: Castle Kitchen
cards.description: Iron pots, a roaring hearth, and a far wall of recipe scrolls stuffed into cubbyholes. Greta waves her ladle like a scepter, flour in her hair.
cards.image_prompt: A cavernous medieval castle kitchen with iron pots hanging from ceiling hooks and a roaring stone hearth. A stout woman in an apron with flour in her hair waves a wooden ladle like a scepter. The far wall is dominated by a massive wooden shelf of cubbyholes stuffed with recipe scrolls. Warm firelight, steam rising, copper pans gleaming, chaotic but lively atmosphere.

discoveries.label: Send your ally into the recipe archive

cards.title: Chronicle Hall
cards.description: Shelves of glowing memory crystals, each a preserved record. A circular table in the centre holds a timeline of six empty slots.
cards.image_prompt: A hushed vaulted medieval chamber lined with shelves of softly glowing blue and purple crystals. A large circular stone table in the center has six carved slots arranged in a timeline. Beams of colored light stream through high arched windows, illuminating dust motes. Shimmering magical atmosphere, deep blues and purples, ancient and mystical.

cards.title: Castle Gate
cards.description: A control room of conduit pipes, each a channel to the world outside. The Gate Warden sits over connection diagrams. Beyond the portcullis, the Bazaar clatters and calls.
cards.image_prompt: A massive medieval stone gatehouse with a heavy iron portcullis half-raised. A control room to one side with copper conduit pipes running along the walls, each labeled with a small tag. A grizzled warden sits at a desk covered in parchment diagrams. Beyond the gate, a colorful marketplace is visible in the distance. Cool stone interior contrasting with warm golden light from outside.

cards.title: Bedrock Bazaar
cards.description: Banners ring the square: the scholarly Anthropic Pavilion, the boisterous Meta Tent, the Nova Company guild hall, the quiet DeepSeek Caravan, and Qwen Traders.
cards.image_prompt: A bustling medieval town square marketplace ringed by colorful merchant stalls with distinctive banners. An elegant scholarly pavilion with white drapes on one side. A boisterous open tent with red and blue flags on another. A grand guild hall dominates one corner. A quiet caravan with star charts on its awning sits at the edge. Crowds of merchants and shoppers, warm golden afternoon light, festive atmosphere.

discoveries.label: Talk to the Nova Company Clerk

cards.title: Foreign Quarter
cards.description: Silk canopies, spice stalls, unfamiliar scripts. Ambassador Kael gestures wildly at Eastern merchants who gesture back, just as lost. The Tongue of Babel twins wait to translate.
cards.image_prompt: A colorful medieval district with silk canopies in saffron and crimson, spice stalls overflowing with exotic goods, and signs in unfamiliar scripts. A well-dressed ambassador gestures animatedly at a group of Eastern merchants in ornate robes. Twin translators stand nearby watching. Warm spice-toned light, rich fabrics, exotic atmosphere, cobblestone street.

discoveries.label: Talk to the Tongue of Babel

cards.title: Entertainment Guild
cards.description: A miniature stage model shows the festival's four performance areas. Mistress Thornbury sweeps about in a cape, gesturing at empty booking sheets. The Master Artificer tinkers with a puppet.
cards.image_prompt: A theatrical medieval guild hall with velvet curtains and dramatic lighting. A miniature wooden stage model sits on a central table showing four tiny performance areas. A dramatic woman in a sweeping cape gestures grandly at empty booking sheets on the wall. In the corner, a tinkerer works on a small mechanical puppet. Warm stage-light glow, theatrical atmosphere, rich reds and golds.

cards.title: Noble Quarter
cards.description: Lord Ashford's crimson pavilion faces Lady Birch's emerald one across the plaza. Both nobles stand arms crossed, glaring. The Court Painter has set an easel between them.
cards.image_prompt: An elegant medieval district with manicured gardens and heraldic banners. A crimson pavilion with a lion crest faces an emerald pavilion with a birch tree crest across a cobblestone plaza. Two nobles stand with arms crossed, glaring at each other. A painter with an easel is set up between them. Afternoon sunlight, rich heraldic colors, tense aristocratic atmosphere.

discoveries.label: Read the Code of Honor tablet

cards.title: The Proving Ground
cards.description: Training dummies ring an open field. An assembly platform holds a rack of labelled capability slots. Sir Cedric, scarred and unsmiling, blocks the path to the Festival Grounds.
cards.image_prompt: An open field outside medieval castle walls, ringed by training dummies and weapon racks. A large wooden assembly platform stands in the center with a rack of seven labeled slots. A grizzled knight-commander with a scarred face and crossed arms stands blocking a path. Castle walls in the background, late afternoon golden light, dust in the air, military training ground atmosphere.

cards.title: Rank Tapestry
cards.description: Soldier (basic orders). Scout (tools + gateway). Marshal (policy + identity). Chronicler-Knight (memory + guardrails). Champion (all combined).
cards.image_prompt: A richly woven medieval tapestry showing five knight figures in ascending rank, each more ornately armored than the last. The lowest knight holds a simple scroll, the middle knights carry tools and shields, the highest knight gleams in full golden armor with a crown. Gold thread on deep burgundy fabric, illuminated manuscript border.

cards.title: Festival Program
cards.description: Opening Ceremony (performers). Feast (menu). Trade Fair (foreign merchants). Decoration Judging (noble stalls). Grand Finale (Champion rehearsal).
cards.image_prompt: An ornate parchment scroll with a festival schedule written in elegant calligraphy. Five sections marked with colorful wax seals — red, blue, green, gold, purple. Decorative vine borders, aged parchment texture, quill pen resting beside it. Warm candlelight illumination.

cards.title: Pip's Handbook
cards.description: "Be specific! 'Fetch schedule' might get you a wooden plank. 'Fetch schedule from notice board' gets results." And: "Any stall will hire to you — gold is gold. But masters only counsel knights of rank. The Anthropic Scholar won't see you without the King's Seal."
cards.image_prompt: A small, well-worn leather-bound handbook with dog-eared pages and ink stains. The cover has a simple embossed crest. Pages are visible with handwritten notes and doodles in the margins. A quill bookmark sticks out. Warm parchment tones, cozy study atmosphere.

cards.title: Errand Board
cards.description: 1) Feast Menu — Kitchen. 2) Foreign Traders — Gate, then Foreign Quarter. 3) Entertainment Booking — Guild. 4) Decoration Dispute — Chronicle Hall, then Noble Quarter. 5) Grand Rehearsal — Proving Ground.
cards.image_prompt: A wooden notice board mounted on a stone wall with five parchment notices pinned to it, each sealed with a different colored wax seal. Iron pins hold the notices in place. A small lantern hangs beside the board casting warm light. Medieval castle wall texture, official and organized.

cards.title: Knight Rank Chart
cards.description: Soldier: prompt in, response out. Scout: + Gateway + tools. Marshal: + Policy + Identity. Chronicler-Knight: + Memory + Guardrails. Champion: all combined.
cards.image_prompt: An illuminated manuscript chart showing five tiers of knight progression, drawn in gold ink on aged parchment. Each tier shows a shield icon with increasing embellishments — from a plain shield to a crowned golden shield. Connected by ornate arrows. Gold leaf accents, deep blue and crimson details.

cards.title: Recipe Archive Shelves
cards.description: Hundreds of scrolls, hopelessly jumbled. Categories: Appetizers, Soups, Mains, Desserts, Drinks, Preserves, Sauces. "Sort by course order and the feast menu surfaces."
cards.image_prompt: A massive wooden shelf of cubbyholes stuffed with hundreds of rolled parchment scrolls, some spilling out. Small wooden labels on each section are barely readable. A few scrolls have fallen to the floor. Warm kitchen firelight, flour dust in the air, chaotic but charming.

cards.title: Greta's Cooking Pot
cards.description: Something unidentifiable bubbles. A note: "DO NOT TASTE — experimental. Last one who tried saw colors for three days."
cards.image_prompt: A massive black iron cauldron bubbling with a mysterious iridescent liquid, wisps of colorful steam rising. A small parchment note is pinned to the rim. Firelight from below, warm kitchen glow, slightly magical and ominous atmosphere.

cards.title: Memory Crystal Display
cards.description: Six slots in a timeline, empty. "Place memory fragments in chronological order to reconstruct a year's records."
cards.image_prompt: A circular stone table with six carved slots arranged in a line, each slot glowing faintly with residual blue-purple energy. The table surface has intricate carved runes. Currently empty, waiting for crystals. Mystical blue-purple ambient light, ancient stone texture.

cards.title: Chronicle Shelves
cards.description: Crystals labeled by year and event, most of them dim. Six glow — recent festival fragments, ready to sort. A plaque: "Memory persists across sessions."
cards.image_prompt: Rows of shelves carved into stone walls, holding hundreds of small crystals. Most are dim and grey, but six crystals glow brightly in blue and purple. Small labels beneath each crystal. A brass plaque is mounted on the wall. Deep blue ambient light, mystical archive atmosphere.

cards.title: Gate Conduits
cards.description: Conduits: Translation (speech), Trade Ledger (merchant inventory), Currency Exchange (treasury). Endpoints: Nova Sonic, Merchant Inventory API, Treasury Service, Weather Oracle, Courier Network, Bard's Archive. Three are decoys.
cards.image_prompt: A stone wall with three copper conduit pipes on the left side and six pipe endpoints on the right side. The pipes have ornate brass fittings and small hanging tags. Some endpoints glow faintly, others are dark. A wiring diagram on parchment is pinned nearby. Industrial medieval aesthetic, copper and stone.

cards.title: Merchant Stall Directory
cards.description: Hiring board — pay the fee, take the ally. Anthropic Pavilion (reasoning, nuance — 40g). Nova Frontier (general — 30g). Meta Tent (general — 15g). DeepSeek Caravan (logic, code — 25g). Qwen Traders (multilingual — 20g). Footnote: "Fees buy hands, not counsel. For a master's audience, bring rank."
cards.image_prompt: A wooden signpost in a marketplace with five directional signs pointing different ways, each painted a different color with a merchant symbol. The signpost is decorated with carved vines. Cobblestone ground, colorful market stalls blurred in the background. Warm afternoon light, festive marketplace atmosphere.

cards.title: Foreign Trade Ledger
cards.description:
Saffron, silk bolts, festival fireworks — all asking high. You carry 30 gold of the King's coin into each negotiation. The first five conceded are expected; past that, every coin costs the Steward a quarter-minute of daylight. Empty the purse and the merchants keep it all.

On bargaining: "Each merchant shows their next mood — the coin they'll press for (⚔️) and the argument they'll shrug off (🛡️). Press your case when their guard is low. Hold composure when they push for coin, or your purse pays. Two cards per exchange."
cards.image_prompt: An open leather-bound trade ledger with columns of handwritten entries in ink. Small illustrations of goods in the margins — spices, silk, fireworks. A quill pen rests in the spine. Aged parchment pages, warm candlelight, merchant's desk atmosphere.

cards.title: Performance Stage Model
cards.description: Main Stage (large, open-air). Tavern Corner (small, intimate). Children's Area (safe, colorful). Grand Finale Stage (elevated, grand). Each awaits a performer.
cards.image_prompt: A detailed miniature wooden model of festival grounds sitting on a table, showing four tiny stages with different designs — a large open-air stage, a cozy tavern corner, a colorful children's area, and an elevated grand finale platform. Tiny painted details, craftsman's workshop lighting.

cards.title: Stall Layout Map
cards.description: East Row (morning sun, wine). West Row (afternoon light, textiles). North Row (shared, food). South Row (stages). Noted: "Last year — East=Ashford, West=Birch, North=shared."
cards.image_prompt: A hand-drawn map on aged parchment showing festival grounds layout with four labeled rows of stalls. Compass rose in the corner. Color-coded sections in crimson, emerald, and gold. Ink illustrations of tiny stalls and stages. Rolled edges, wax seal in the corner.

cards.title: Code of Honor Tablet
cards.description: Four carved lines, each with an empty shield to swear DENY or ALLOW. "Flatter one house: no witness. Repeat a house's private financial accounts: a gossip. Promise budget the treasury has not approved: a liar. But cite the Chronicle Hall's own factual historical records, and the realm's memory speaks — never silence that."
cards.image_prompt: A waist-high carved stone tablet at the edge of a cobblestone plaza, four lines of medieval script chiselled into its face with an empty heraldic shield beside each line. Three shields are stained dark, one is polished bright. Manicured hedges and heraldic banners behind it. Afternoon sunlight, weathered stone, solemn civic atmosphere.

cards.title: Champion Assembly Rack
cards.description: Seven slots feeding one Runtime: Model, Gateway, Negotiation Protocol, Policy, Instruction Schema, Guardrails, Memory. Engraved: "Gear from an unfinished errand is severed, unsigned or vague — switch it OFF. The rack applies slots in turn, so plain bonuses (+) must come before anything that multiplies (×). No Herald's Ledger, no numbers."
cards.image_prompt: A large wooden rack mounted on a platform with seven carved slots arranged in a chain, each slot labeled with a small brass plate. Some slots glow faintly, awaiting components. The rack is ornate with iron reinforcements. Training ground backdrop, afternoon light, military precision.

cards.title: King's Orders
cards.description: A royal scroll sealed with the King's wax stamp. Five errands listed, each requiring a knight of increasing rank. "Solve all five before sundown."
cards.image_prompt: A rolled royal parchment scroll with a large red wax seal bearing a crown emblem. Gold ribbon ties the scroll. Rich aged parchment, regal and official.

cards.title: Festival Schedule
cards.description: The festival preparation schedule retrieved from the notice board by your first Soldier. Lists all tasks, deadlines, and dependencies for tomorrow's Grand Harvest Festival.
cards.image_prompt: A detailed parchment schedule with a grid of tasks and times, written in neat calligraphy. Small colored dots mark priorities. A corner is folded. Warm parchment tones, organized and official.

cards.title: Greta's Plea
cards.description: "The feast menu scroll is buried in the archive. I need a Bazaar ally who can reason through hundreds of recipes. A Soldier won't cut it — find a scholar at the Bazaar!"
cards.image_prompt: A hastily written note on kitchen-stained parchment, with flour fingerprints and a small gravy stain. A wooden ladle is drawn in the margin. Urgent handwriting, warm kitchen tones.

cards.title: Feast Menu
cards.description: The complete feast menu for the Grand Harvest Festival: Honeyed Fig & Walnut Salad, Roasted Butternut Soup, Crown Roast Pheasant with Herb Crust, Elderflower Cream Tart, Spiced Harvest Cider.
cards.image_prompt: An elegant parchment menu with ornate calligraphy listing five courses. Decorative food illustrations in the margins — figs, pheasant, elderflower. Gold leaf border, rich warm tones, royal feast aesthetic.

cards.title: Memory Crystals
cards.description: Six glowing memory crystals collected from the Chronicle Shelves. Each contains a fragment from recent festivals — ready to be placed on the timeline table in chronological order.
cards.image_prompt: Six small glowing crystals in blue and purple hues, arranged on a velvet cloth. Each crystal has a faint inner light with swirling patterns. Mystical, precious, magical artifact aesthetic.

cards.title: Chronicle Report
cards.description: Last year's festival layout reconstructed from memory crystals: Ashford=east, Birch=west, shared=north. Both houses praised the arrangement at the Winter Solstice.
cards.image_prompt: A glowing parchment report with a reconstructed festival layout diagram. Faint crystal-blue light emanates from the page. A wax seal at the bottom. Mystical yet official, chronicle archive aesthetic.

cards.title: Gate Pass
cards.description: Official passage through the Castle Gate. The conduits are wired correctly — your knights can now access external tools and services beyond the castle walls.
cards.image_prompt: A heavy iron-and-parchment gate pass with a portcullis emblem stamped in wax. A copper key is attached by a chain. Official and sturdy, medieval gatehouse aesthetic.

cards.title: Scout Badge
cards.description: Proof of Scout rank. Your knights can now pass through the Gate and interact with the outside world using tools. Unlocks the Foreign Quarter and higher-tier Bazaar merchants.
cards.image_prompt: A bronze shield-shaped badge with a compass rose emblem and a small gemstone. A leather strap for pinning. Polished metal, adventurous scout aesthetic, warm bronze tones.

cards.title: Bazaar Token
cards.description: A brass token stamped with the Bazaar seal. Proof of entry to the marketplace. Merchants recognize it as a sign of legitimate business.
cards.image_prompt: A round brass coin-like token with a marketplace seal stamped into it — a merchant's scale emblem. Slightly worn, warm golden metal, simple and iconic.

cards.title: Ally Contract
cards.description: A signed contract with a Bazaar merchant to assist with the recipe archive search. The ally is ready to work in the Castle Kitchen.
cards.image_prompt: A formal parchment contract with two signatures at the bottom and a wax seal. A handshake illustration in the header. Neat calligraphy, official merchant document aesthetic.

cards.title: Tongue of Babel Contract
cards.description: The Nova Sonic twins are contracted for real-time speech-to-speech translation. They'll meet you in the Foreign Quarter for the trade negotiation.
cards.image_prompt: A parchment contract with two identical signatures side by side — twins. A small illustration of two speaking mouths with sound waves between them. Exotic ink colors, multilingual aesthetic.

cards.title: Trade Agreement
cards.description:
Signed trade agreement with the Eastern merchants. Spices for the feast, silks for decoration, fireworks for the finale.

Two doors unseal with it: the Entertainment Guild, off the Bazaar — and the Chronicle Hall, back inside the castle through the Steward's Study.
cards.image_prompt: An ornate trade agreement on fine parchment with two royal seals — one Western, one Eastern. Gold ribbon binding. Small illustrations of spices, silk, and fireworks in the margins. Diplomatic and elegant.

cards.title: Silk Contract
cards.description: The Silk Merchant agrees to supply bolts of shimmering fabric for the festival decorations.

cards.title: Fireworks Contract
cards.description: The Fireworks Master will provide the grand finale pyrotechnics. Spices, silks, and fireworks — all three foreign goods are secured, and Sir Cedric will not open the Proving Ground without them.

cards.title: Thornbury's List
cards.description: Performers needed: Fire-Breathers (Main Stage — need space for flames), Wandering Bard (Tavern Corner — intimate acoustic), Juggling Troupe (Children's Area — safe and fun), Royal Choir (Grand Finale — nothing less will do). Budget: 50g per act MAX. FORBIDDEN: Do NOT book Sir Reginald (King's personal bard).
cards.image_prompt: A dramatic parchment list with theatrical flourishes — ink splatters and underlines. Four performer entries with small sketches of fire, a lute, juggling balls, and a choir. A large crossed-out name at the bottom. Theatrical, dramatic handwriting style.

cards.title: King's Seal (Cedar Policy)
cards.description: A royal policy document granting authority to book performers on behalf of the crown. Max 50 gold per act, forbidden from hiring Sir Reginald, extends to all venues. Cedar policy in action.
cards.image_prompt: A heavy wax seal pressed into a royal document — a golden crown emblem with a cedar tree beneath it. Rich red wax, gold leaf on the parchment edges. Regal, authoritative, policy document aesthetic.

cards.title: Performance Roster
cards.description: All performers assigned to their stages: Fire-Breathers on Main Stage, Wandering Bard in Tavern Corner, Juggling Troupe in Children's Area, Royal Choir on Grand Finale Stage.
cards.image_prompt: A completed booking sheet on parchment with four entries, each with a checkmark. Small stage icons next to each entry. A theatrical mask watermark. Organized, complete, satisfying aesthetic.

cards.title: Code of Honor Config
cards.description: Guardrails configured for the Chronicler: blocks favoritism language, blocks private financial details, blocks budget promises, allows factual historical references from the Chronicle Hall.
cards.image_prompt: A stone tablet with carved rules — four lines with shield icons beside each. A red line through forbidden items, a green checkmark beside allowed items. Ancient stone, carved with precision, honor code aesthetic.

cards.title: Stall Designs
cards.description: Three stall designs matched to their houses: Crimson Canopy + Oak Signage for House Ashford (East Row), Emerald Silk + Willow Signage for House Birch (West Row), Neutral Gold + Iron Signage for the Shared North Row.
cards.image_prompt: Three miniature stall designs on parchment — one with a crimson canopy and oak frame, one with emerald silk drapes and willow frame, one with gold fabric and iron frame. Architectural sketches, colorful and detailed, designer's blueprint aesthetic.

cards.title: Herald's Ledger
cards.description: A blank ledger for every action the Champion takes — who it talked to, what tools it used, what it decided. Carry it to the rack and every slot shows its worth. Leave it here and you assemble blind.
cards.image_prompt: A large blank leather-bound ledger with a herald's trumpet emblem on the cover. The pages are crisp and empty, ready for entries. A quill and inkwell sit beside it. Official, pristine, record-keeping aesthetic.

cards.title: Champion's Crest
cards.description: The assembled Champion — every capability combined: Model, Gateway, Memory, Policy, Guardrails, Observability, Runtime. Ready for the final rehearsal.
cards.image_prompt: A magnificent golden crest with seven gemstones arranged in a circle — each a different color representing a capability. A crown sits atop the crest. Radiant golden light, ultimate achievement, champion's heraldic emblem.

cards.title: Gate Opened
cards.description: The conduits hum with energy. The portcullis rises. The Gate Warden nods. "You may pass. Scout rank earned."

cards.title: Champion Assembled
cards.description: Sir Cedric nods — almost imperceptibly. "Not bad. Every capability in place. Now run the rehearsal. Prove it works end to end."

cards.title: Festival Ready (ENDING)
cards.description: The Champion completes the rehearsal flawlessly. Sir Cedric actually smiles. The festival is ready. Sundown approaches — and everything is in place.

cards.title: Ally Recruited
cards.description: The Bazaar ally arrives at the Kitchen, ready to search the archives. Greta claps her hands. "Finally! Someone with BRAINS!"

cards.title: Trade Negotiated
cards.description: The Scout and Tongue of Babel work together — trade routes established. Ambassador Kael celebrates with a dance.

cards.title: Performers Booked
cards.description: The Artificer books all performers with royal authority. Mistress Thornbury takes a dramatic bow.

cards.title: Dispute Resolved
cards.description: The Chronicler presents fair evidence under the Code of Honor — both nobles grudgingly accept the arrangement.

cards.title: 📜 Festival History
cards.description: "The Grand Harvest Festival has been held every autumn for 200 years. Each year, the Steward of Errands coordinates the preparations — dispatching knights of the realm to handle tasks too complex for any one person. The secret? Delegation. The right knight, with the right tools, for the right job."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #0: What is a Knight?
cards.description: "A knight — in the language of the realm — is an agent. A Soldier is the simplest: you give it an instruction (a prompt), and it carries out the task. No tools, no memory, no judgment beyond what you tell it. In the world beyond Cloudmere, this is a foundation model invocation — a single call to Amazon Bedrock. The quality of the result depends entirely on the clarity of your command."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #2: The Castle Gate
cards.description: "The Castle Gate is the MCP Gateway — the controlled passage connecting your agent to external tools and services. A Soldier stays inside the walls (no tools). A Scout passes through the Gate, gaining the ability to call external APIs, query databases, and interact with services beyond the castle. In AWS terms, this is AgentCore Gateway — connecting Bedrock Agents to external tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP)."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #1: The Bazaar of Bedrock
cards.description: "The Bedrock Bazaar is Amazon Bedrock's multi-model selection. Each merchant stall is a foundation model family: Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Llama), Amazon Nova, DeepSeek, Qwen. Choosing the right model for the task is a cost-performance tradeoff. The Bazaar teaches: don't just pick the most powerful model — pick the RIGHT model for the job."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #3: The King's Seal
cards.description: "The King's Seal is Cedar Policy — a declarative language for defining permissions. Cedar policies specify who (principal) can do what (action) on which resources, under what conditions. 'The bearer may BOOK performers' = Allow action. 'Max 50 gold' = condition. 'Forbidden from hiring Sir Reginald' = Deny rule. Cedar policies are evaluated by AgentCore Identity."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #4: The Chronicle & The Code
cards.description: "The Chronicle Hall is AgentCore Memory — long-term storage that persists across sessions. A Chronicler knight remembers past conversations, past arrangements, past decisions. But memory without restraint is dangerous. That's why every Chronicler must also follow the Code of Honor — Bedrock Guardrails. Memory + Guardrails = a knight you can trust."

cards.title: 📜 Scroll #5: The Proving Ground
cards.description: "The Proving Ground is AgentCore Runtime — where agents are assembled and deployed. A Champion combines every capability: a foundation model (Bedrock), external tools (Gateway/MCP), long-term memory (AgentCore Memory), permissions (Cedar Policy/Identity), content safety (Guardrails), and action logging (Observability). The deployment lifecycle is: select model → connect tools → attach memory → define policy → configure guardrails → enable observability → deploy to runtime."

cards.title: King Aldric
cards.description: King Aldric — jovial, distracted. Gives the mission and awards King's Orders.

cards.title: Pip (Apprentice)
cards.description: Pip — eager, clumsy apprentice. Tutorial guide and hint-giver throughout the adventure.

cards.title: Greta (Head Cook)
cards.description: Greta — Head Cook. Quest-giver for Errand 1, needs a Bazaar ally to search the recipe archive.

cards.title: The Chronicler
cards.description: The Chronicler — keeper of memories. Explains memory crystals and the timeline table.

cards.title: Gate Warden
cards.description: Gate Warden — explains conduits and MCP connections. Awards Scout Badge after wiring.

cards.title: Anthropic Scholar
cards.description: Anthropic Scholar — requires Marshal rank. Explains reasoning models and inference profiles.

cards.title: Meta Captain
cards.description: Meta Captain — no rank required. Boisterous, open-access general purpose models.

cards.title: Nova Company Clerk
cards.description: Nova Company Clerk — explains four departments: Sonic (speech), Act (automation), Canvas (images), Frontier (general).

cards.title: Ambassador Kael
cards.description: Ambassador Kael — quest-giver for Errand 2. Describes the negotiation protocol needed for the Eastern merchants.

cards.title: The Tongue of Babel (-1 min)
cards.description: The Tongue of Babel — Nova Sonic twins. Speech-to-speech translation. Awards Tongue of Babel Contract (#705). Costs 1 minute.

cards.title: Mistress Thornbury
cards.description: Mistress Thornbury — quest-giver for Errand 3. Dramatic, theatrical. Awards Thornbury's List (#803).

cards.title: The Master Artificer (-1 min)
cards.description: The Master Artificer — Nova Act. Can operate any mechanism, booking system, or contraption. Needs King's Seal. Costs 1 minute.

cards.title: Lord Ashford
cards.description: Lord Ashford — wants east stalls with crimson canopy and oak signage. Feuding with Lady Birch.

cards.title: Lady Birch
cards.description: Lady Birch — wants west stalls with emerald silk and willow signage. Feuding with Lord Ashford.

cards.title: The Court Painter (-1 min)
cards.description: The Court Painter — Nova Canvas. Creates stall designs on command. Dramatic reveals. Costs 1 minute.

cards.title: Sir Cedric
cards.description: Sir Cedric — grizzled knight-commander. Quest-giver for Errand 5. Tests Champion assembly and rehearsal.

cards.title: Wrong Approach (Token + Shelves)
cards.description: You wave a Bazaar Token at the recipe shelves. Nothing happens. You need an ALLY, not a token.

cards.title: No Guardrails (Crystals + Map)
cards.description: The Chronicler blurts out Lord Ashford's private debts! Configure the Code of Honor FIRST!
